name: Le Coucou
address: 11 Howard Hotel, 138 Lafayette St., New York, NY, 10013
dinnerNote: A Very Coucou Dinner tasting menu (à la carte mains $51–$95)
lunchNote: Two-course lunch prix fixe (3 courses $125; A Very Coucou Lunch $150)

menus.name: A Very Coucou Dinner
menus.note: Wine pairing $145, or $345 for the grander one; non-alcoholic pairing $115. À la carte also served, with mains $51–$95

menus.name: Three-course lunch prix fixe
menus.note: Supplements for some dishes, such as the beef tartare with caviar and the lobster

bookingOpens: Online on Resy, 28 days ahead for parties of one to six.
cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead to avoid a $50 per guest fee.
groups: For seven or more, call the restaurant; parties of 7 to 10 have the four-course group menu ($240). For more than 10, email the events team (lecoucou.events@starr-restaurants.com): lunch is available for 11 or more, and larger dinners only as a buyout.
dressCode: Elegant, as for a night out in New York. Jackets are not required, but athletic wear is not allowed, and guests who aren't well enough dressed may be refused entry.
photoAlt: The entrance of Le Coucou at 138 Lafayette Street, Manhattan, framed by plants
